title: Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid (al-Tamhīd fī Sharḥ Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd)
transliterated_title: Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid or al-Tamhīd fī Sharḥ Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd (Introduction to The Principles of Divine Unity; variant al-Shahīd fī Sharḥ Risālat al-Tawḥīd)
genre: commentary on his grandfather Ṣadr al-Dīn's Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd

date.basis: MS Majlis 10196 copy date and place (Shiraz), asterisked by Melvin-Koushki as possibly transcription; the timeline states completion in Shiraz in 830/1427 and the thematic list gives it with a question mark.

place: Shiraz (place of the Majlis copy; the timeline treats it as place of completion)
occasion: a commentary on his grandfather Ṣadr al-Dīn's Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd
manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 189b-23a (as printed); MS Sipahsālār 2930/9 ff. 141-277 (845/1441); 22 copies listed, most of the 19th century.
majlis_folios: ff. 189b-23a (as printed; the end is presumably f. 223a, since the next work, no. 37, begins on f. 223b)
summary: Ibn Turka's commentary on his grandfather Ṣadr al-Dīn's treatise on absolute existence, joining peripatetic and illuminationist philosophy to Ibn ʿArabian mysticism; by far his best-known work in the modern period, and the reason for his placing between Ibn ʿArabī and Mullā Ṣadrā.
edition_note: Ed. Ḥasan al-Ramaḍānī al-Khurasānī, Beirut 2003; ed. Jalāl al-Dīn Āshtiyānī, Tehran 1976 (repr. 1981, 2002); Javādī-Āmulī's Taḥrīr-i Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid (Persian commentary, 1993); Arabic text, so a player reads it in these editions.
